variants.headline: Looking back: business-start grant programme ends
variants.sub: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business had ended.

A person trying to start a business is still a person whose household matters. Labour should consider public support through that ordinary perspective, rather than assume that the word 'enterprise' removes the need for fairness. A programme deserves scrutiny for its accessibility as well as its stated ambition.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We criticise {target} on the standard of public support. A programme's ending should not put its stewardship beyond question or allow its attractive purpose to stand in for a serious account of performance.
